category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The product is positioned for damaged/dry hair repair rather than a named scalp concern; the ordinary balanced scalp route is the only supported production target.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 and early sodium chloride make this an effective cleanser, but CAPB plus a very early cationic polymer/panthenol/oil/silicone care phase keeps the net architecture below a strong reset shampoo. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: coarse — Coarse hair is the best default fit for the high-conditioning/high-weight repair profile; the richer deposition is less likely to compromise useful movement. Conditional (not emitted): normal — The repair-care stack can help damaged normal hair, but high weight potential makes it situational rather than an ideal diameter-level default.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 and early sodium chloride make this an effective cleanser, but CAPB plus a very early cationic polymer/panthenol/oil/silicone care phase keeps the net architecture below a strong reset shampoo.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: High: early cationic guar, panthenol, apricot oil, coconut extract and later amodimethicone/dimethicone create multiple complementary rinse-off care routes.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete canonical formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: exact-product positioning targets damaged/dry hair and repair, and the formula supports that with polymer, panthenol, oil and silicone care routes.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the dry-hair and smoothing claims support the same repair/care story rather than a distinct v1.4 secondary focus.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the product targets damaged/dry hair fiber repair, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are ordinary wet-hair distribution, short contact and rinse-out, with no daily, alternating, reset or treatment trigger.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: High: early cationic guar, plant oil, dual silicones and later waxy/refatting materials create converging persistent deposition potential despite SLES/CAPB reset.
